matrix: Open idea, ambiguous goal, exploring direction
If plan already approved, bypass to plan-execution.
Architecture settled, breaking into actionable tasks
If tasks are single-file/trivial (<50 LOC), execute inline.
Approved plan ready for sequential execution
If scope is newly ambiguous, reopen brainstorming.
If cause is confirmed and fix is small, execute inline.
If local code already provides utility, adopt local code.
Decoupled tasks across disjoint write paths
If tasks share state or common cause, execute inline.
If code is merely ugly but passing, keep unchanged.
Code or behavioral contract ready for correctness review
Use natural-writing only for prose/style review, not execution or safety contracts.
Authoring or maintaining a skill or procedure
For passive repository guidance, use agent-document-authoring; auditing such files can still be an executable skill.
Zero method loading: execute directly without ceremony.
